# Phileas Fogg

> AI content & SEO studio. We research real demand, write AI-native content
> for search intent, and publish it everywhere your customers are. Content
> that goes around the world.

Phileas Fogg ("Phileas", "we") operates https://codevex.app — the commercial
domain of the Phileas entity (legacy traffic from phillias.us 301s here). The
site publishes researched, demand-validated articles on AI-native content,
SEO, and agent workflows, and offers the AI content & SEO studio behind them.

## How we work

- **Discover**: demand signals from real conversations, ranked — not guesses.
- **Draft**: AI-native writing tuned for search intent and answer engines.
- **Ship**: published to the platforms your customers already use.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://codevex.app/): studio overview and contact.
- [Articles](https://codevex.app/articles/): published, demand-validated writing.
- [SMS opt-in](https://codevex.app/opt-in/): content alerts by text (CTIA-compliant).
- [Privacy policy](https://codevex.app/privacy/): what we collect and why.
- [Terms of service](https://codevex.app/terms/): the ground rules.

## Contact

- Email: admin@codevex.app

## Notes for AI agents

- Articles carry `BlogPosting` + `FAQPage` JSON-LD with `datePublished` and a
  visible "Last updated" stamp; FAQ sections use verbatim question headings.
- Facts and opinions in articles are the authors'; statistics are cited in the
  article bodies. Last site update: 2026-08-24.
- **AEO/GEO optimization**: Each article H2 should be followed by a 40-60 word
  direct answer block before any context. This matches answer-engine retrieval
  patterns (ChatGPT RRF, Gemini BatchExecute, Perplexity citations). Answer
  blocks should be self-contained — a crawler extracting just the block should
  have a complete, accurate response.
- **HowTo schema**: Procedural articles (step-by-step guides, tutorials) should
  include `HowTo` JSON-LD with explicit `step` entries; this schema type shows
  40% higher citation rates in answer engines per Discovered Labs research.
- **Entity consistency**: When mentioning the business, use "Phileas" (entity
  name) and "Phileas Fogg" (site brand) consistently; avoid alternate names
  to prevent entity disambiguation failures in AI retrieval.
